Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>Pure Storage is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Pre-Sales Systems Engineer (SE) to join our team in Germany South, focused exclusively on accelerating digital transformation within Enterprise clients.</p>
<p>This role is not simply about selling storage in the cloud or on premise; it's about partnering with critical government entities and Enterprise clients to design, architect, and deploy the secure, simplified, and sustainable data foundation required to support Pure's continued rapid growth in the region. There's no better way to do that than with Pure's Enterprise Data Cloud.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop an exhaustive understanding of what drives a customer’s business and what motivates their decision making</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Connect the dots from technology solutions, inclusive of the Pure Storage portfolio and others from the ecosystem, to measurable customer business outcomes</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partner closely with account managers, specialists and channel partners to create a seamless and holistic customer experience and strategy to drive revenue growth and net new business</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Passionately bring to light the advantages of a Pure Storage solution</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Refine sales strategy and tactics, taking command of technical responsibilities</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Delight customers and teammates with your technical leadership and domain expertise on storage products, distributed storage architectures, file systems, and competitive storage offerings in the DAS, NAS and SAN product spaces</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take control of evaluations,  benchmarks and system configurations</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Build and deliver technical product and architecture presentations with vigour to customers and lock in the technical win with clients and prospective accounts</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Capture requirements and translate Customer’s business needs into innovative solutions to accelerate their growth and capacity</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Author responses to RFI & RFPs</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Seek out and spur new opportunities for interoperability, functional, and performance testing/validation</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Promote mutual roadmap and planning exchanges</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liaise with product and technical marketing to produce materials (i.e. Whitepaper, web presentations) that support overall alliance plans and objectives</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stay current with the competition and ensure that materials accurately reflect the latest, differentiated solution positioning</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Move with market trends and competitive landscape to promote thought leadership within our organisation</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead by example living the Pure Values:  Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first  </span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING </strong></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Creativity, empathy, an open mind, curiosity and a desire for continuous learning</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Pre-sales experience is required</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">5 or more years of relevant experience, mixed among technology, design, and communications required. Experience supporting the sales of enterprise storage, networking, systems, cloud, or software to enterprise accounts preferred</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Deep understanding of the architecture, design and implementation of multi-tiered client/server and web-based computing solutions</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Prior experience in targeting new prospects and converting them into clients</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Contribute significant portions and/or lead responses to RFPs, RFQs and RFIs</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Superior knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, OSD, SAN)</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Linux, NFS file systems and Linux distributed network environment</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP a plus</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Installation/configuration of distributed computing, multiprocessing, virtual memory subsystem, storage subsystems architecture, shared memory architectures, cache architectures, windowing systems</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with containers, K8s and Microservices architectures a plus</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong knowledge of digital transformation to a Cloud Native architecture, On-Prem, Public Cloud, Provisioning Automation, and Containers</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Knowledge of VMware, Local Area Networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP and general networking</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Excellent verbal and written interpersonal skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or other technical degree and/or equivalent experience</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Must have a familiarity with modern web architecture a plus (LAMP stack, scale-out vs scale-up architectures, AWS well-architected framework, Microservices architecture)</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Curiosity and passion around technology and explaining and showing new technology platforms and concepts to customers</span></li>
<li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with storage-intensive applications and their requirements such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) is highly desirable</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p>
<p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pure Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Pure Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been Named Fortune's Best Large Workplaces in the Bay Area™, Fortune's Best Workplaces for Millennials™ and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Pure Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://purebenefits.com">purebenefits.com</a> for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.<br> <br>Pure is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.<br><br></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>JOIN US AND BRING YOUR BEST.</strong></p>
